children: Tenet Healthcare issued $2.0 billion of 6.250% senior notes due 2034 under its existing indenture with Bank of New York Mellon as trustee. The company plans to use net proceeds, along with cash on hand, to redeem all $1.5 billion of its 5.125% senior secured first lien notes due 2027 and partially redeem $0.5 billion of its 6.125% senior notes due 2028. The notes include customary covenants and optional redemption provisions, including a make-whole call prior to September 15, 2029. Management expects the transaction to refinance near-term maturities and enhance financial flexibility.

: Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, as trustee
: Refinance 2027 and 2028 notes and extend maturities
